text:
Controlling for inflation and PPP, Japan's GDP per capita increased roughly 8- to 10-fold from 1950 to 2016—from about $3,000–4,000 to $38,000–40,000 in 2011 international dollars. Most of this gain came during the high-growth era of the 1950s–1970s, with much slower growth after the 1990s.
CONFIDENCE: 80
